reviewed_changes: Closed atomic operands admit supported literal/bool/enum constants and safe integer wrappers; effects, runtime/volatile reads, calls and unsupported expressions refuse.

Named enum values require one matching declaration before any value-cache access.
Enum underlying-type selection requires one EnumDecl and no mixed declaration kinds, closing record-sizeof collision.
Anonymous enumerators filter exact reported enum type and require one explicit matching value.
No cross-process Clang AST identifiers compared; atomic enum errors retain operand/source-line context.
Unique enum/repeated value/underlying-type controls and original constant C/anchors/model/name byte checks remain present.
